scripts.copy:public-icons: mkdir -p static/vendor/fontawesome/css static/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css static/vendor/fontawesome/css/all.min.css && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts/fa-solid-900.woff2 static/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts/fa-solid-900.woff2
scripts.build:public: npm run build:public-css && npm run copy:public-icons
